privacy.title: Privacy
body: Adults only. There are no accounts, no passwords and no email.
We store only what the game needs: an age range (never your exact age), gender, preference, genres, an optional nickname, your settings and boundaries, and room progress.
We never store your name, email, phone number, IP address or location. There are no ads, trackers or third-party analytics.
Your session lives in a secure cookie. It is deleted automatically after 3 hours without activity or 24 hours at most. Rooms are deleted 6 hours after their last activity.
You can delete everything immediately with “Delete my data now” in Settings.

terms.title: Terms
body: You must be 18 or older to use this app.
Only play with adults who clearly and enthusiastically want to take part. Anyone can stop at any time, for any reason, using Stop.
Practise safer sex: use condoms and get tested regularly.
The app is provided as is. You are responsible for following the laws where you live.
